2: For the music director. Of David, the servant of Yahweh. An oracle: the wicked has rebellion in the midst of his heart. There is no fear of God before his eyes.
3: For he flatters himself in his eyes, hating to detect his iniquity.
4: The words of his mouth are wickedness and deceit. He has ceased to have insight and to do good.
5: He plans sin on his bed. He puts himself on a way that is not good. He does not reject evil.
6: O Yahweh, your loyal love extends into the heavens, your faithfulness unto the clouds.
7: Your righteousness is ⌞like the mighty mountains⌟, your judgments like the great deep. You save man and beast, O Yahweh.
8: How precious is your loyal love, O God, and the children of humankind take refuge in the shadow of your wings.
9: They are refreshed with the ⌞fullness⌟ of your house, and you give them drink from the river of your delights.
10: For with you is the fountain of life; in your light we see light.
11: Prolong your loyal love to those who know you, and your righteousness to the upright of heart.
12: Do not let a foot of pride come against me, nor let a wicked hand make me to wander homeless.
13: There doers of evil have fallen; they are thrust down and not able to rise.
